grain: one player-game at selected color, opening family, exact time control, and rating band
filters: completed rated Standard, no source-marked bot, known source opening, known focal rating; half-open rating band
null_rules: unknown result and missing focal rating excluded and counted in coverage
caveats: Descriptive association in the observed prefix only.
Do not infer a causal advantage from opening choice.
Focal-player games are dependent across players and opponents; M4 uncertainty method must account for this.
